sources: Sources: ICJ / Just Security Early Edition, SCMP, One Turn daily briefing, Open Chronicle Global News Brief — 20 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: World Court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide against its Rohingya minority — the court's first such finding against a state.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia met in Shenzhen and signed a four-point joint declaration on peace.

stories.headline: Russia launches huge overnight barrage on Ukraine
stories.summary: More than 400 drones and 110 missiles hit Kyiv and nine regions, killing eight; Ukraine hit back at the Crimea Bridge.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq as stocks slide for a fifth day
stories.summary: Anthropic closed about 17% above its $83 IPO price at around $97, while the S&P 500 fell about 2% and Japan's Nikkei dropped 4.8%.

stories.headline: Houthi missile damages Riyadh's tallest tower
stories.summary: A missile strike hit Riyadh's financial district, damaging the Public Investment Fund tower and other buildings in the Saudi capital.

stories.headline: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient
stories.summary: Kenya released its final Ebola patient 37 days after the outbreak's first case, marking the end of the country's Ebola scare.
